<!-- stormworks-research-gap:family:liquid-liquid-heat-exchanger -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts/liquid-liquid-heat-exchanger).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Compartment volumes and the capacity weighting were not recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/24/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The 2x2 and 5x5 variants share the same fraction; a larger internal volume for the 5x5 would raise q, but the volumes were not recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/24/sections/2/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Compare outlet temperatures of both variants at equal pump flow.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/families/24/sections/3/body`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Heat-transfer coefficients, effectiveness, flow dependence and time to equilibrium are unknown. The tooltip's size rule is not a measured performance curve.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/264/limitations/4`

**Definition-only extraction**

> Temperature units and inlet/outlet measurement locations are unspecified. The definition of size in the heat-exchange rule is unknown.

- [wiki/data/families.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/families.json), `/families/264/limitations/5`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Liquid-Liquid Heat Exchanger: decode remaining behavior and formulas
